#!name=易车
#!author=queitstart pro
#!date=2026-11-21
#!format=sgmodule

[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.ycapp\.yiche\.com\/appnews\/getadlist/i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.ycapp\.yiche\.com\/yicheapp\/getadlist/i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/cheyouapi\.ycapp\.yiche\.com\/appforum\/getusermessagecount/i then reject_img(200)

[Rule]
DOMAIN, adx.yiche.com,REJECT
DOMAIN, log.ycapp.yiche.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, bglog.bitauto.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, g.bitauto.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, gimg.bitauto.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, gstat.bitauto.com,REJECT

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% api.ycapp.yiche.com, cheyouapi.ycapp.yiche.com
